item.title: Gov. Tim Walz tells a House panel the Trump immigration crackdown hampered Minnesota’s fraud fight
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — Minnesota’s governor and attorney general on Wednesday defended their efforts to combat fraud and told a U.S. House committee that their efforts have been hampered by President Donald Trump’s immigration crackdown in the state.
